analysis.title: Trane Technologies Plc (TT): 3Q inline with record backlog, pricing and incrementals set to improve
key_insights: TT 3Q26 segment EBIT was inline with FactSet consensus. Stronger Americas EBIT offset softer EMEA/APAC, which were weighed down by the Middle East conflict (over 80% of the operating income decline in EMEA was attributed to the Middle East) and China.
Adj. EPS of $4.86 beat GS/consensus of $4.75/$4.73 but included a ~$0.10 tax timing benefit that reverses in 4Q.
Organic growth was +16% vs GS +10.7%, led by Americas at +19%, where Applied revenues grew over 60%.

Organic orders were +20% (vs 2Q: +37%) with a book-to-bill of 1.07. Backlog reached a record $12.5bn, +73% y/y, of which over $8bn ships in 2027 and beyond (~$2bn more than at the same point last year).
TT now tracks ~1,700 mega projects, up from ~1,400 in 2Q. GS reads the order deceleration as data center lumpiness rather than slowing demand.
Americas Resi HVAC revenues and bookings were both up ~20%, the best among HVAC OEMs. Sell-in matched sell-through and channel inventory remains healthy.

Resi price was lighter than planned because of volume-linked incentives rather than share defense. Price stayed positive and improved sequentially, in contrast to the Resi price/cost pressure peers flagged this quarter.

TT raised FY26 organic growth guidance to +11% (from +9%) and reported growth to +13.5% (from 11.5%), and reaffirmed EPS of $15.20-$15.30. The 4Q EPS guide of ~$3.40-$3.50 is below consensus of $3.62 but absorbs the ~$0.10 tax reversal.

FY26 price assumption was cut to ~1pt from ~1.5pts and organic leverage to low-20s from 25%+, attributed to transitory short-cycle mix and a one-time UFLPA-driven component disruption that TT says is now fully behind it.
4Q price is expected to accelerate to ~1.5pts (~2pts in Americas) with incrementals above the 25%+ target. GS expects organic growth to accelerate in 2027 with a return to 25%+ incrementals.

GS reiterates Buy and would view weakness on the 4Q guide as a buying opportunity. The 12-month price target moves to $556 from $565 on a lower target multiple of 20.0x Q5-Q8 EBITDA (from 21.0x), reflecting a de-rating across HVAC OEMs; it implies a ~4% 2028E FCF yield.

GS lowered FY26/FY27/FY28 EPS estimates to $15.30/$18.25/$21.45 (from $15.40/$18.30/$21.50) to reflect the reversal of the 3Q tax timing benefit. Revenue estimates were raised to $24,133mn/$26,912mn/$29,505mn.

market_movers.rationale: Record backlog of $12.5bn, improving price and a return to 25%+ incrementals in 2027. Price target cut to $556 from $565 on a lower target multiple reflecting HVAC OEM de-rating. Implies 29.0% upside from $431.10.

sector_views.rationale: GS notes a de-rating across HVAC OEMs and lowers its target multiple for TT, while Americas Resi and data center Applied demand remain strong.

earnings_insights: TT 3Q26 adj. EPS reported $4.86 (includes ~$0.10 tax timing benefit) vs GS estimate $4.75 and FactSet consensus $4.73.
3Q26 segment EBIT was -1% vs GS estimate and inline with FactSet consensus.
3Q26 organic growth reported +16% vs GS estimate +10.7%. Organic bookings +20% vs 2Q: +37%. Book-to-bill 1.07.
FY26 EPS guidance reaffirmed at $15.20-$15.30. 4Q26 EPS guide ~$3.40-$3.50 vs FactSet consensus $3.62, which includes the ~$0.10 tax reversal.
FY26 organic sales growth guide raised to +11% from +9%. Reported growth guide raised to +13.5% from 11.5%.
GS estimates after the print: FY26E EPS $15.30, FY27E $18.25, FY28E $21.45 (prior $15.40/$18.30/$21.50). GS 3Q26E-1Q27E quarterly EPS path: 4Q26E $3.49, 1Q27E $3.34, 2Q27E $5.14.
risk_factors: Slower Applied and data center demand or backlog conversion
geopolitical: The Middle East conflict weighed on TT's EMEA results, with over 80% of the operating income decline in EMEA attributed to it.
A UFLPA-driven (Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act) component disruption hurt FY26 price and organic leverage; TT says it is now fully behind it.

tension_points.bull_case: Record $12.5bn backlog, ~1,700 mega projects tracked, Americas Resi HVAC up ~20%, price improving to ~1.5pts in 4Q and incrementals above 25%+ target, setting up organic growth acceleration in 2027.
tension_points.bear_case: The 4Q EPS guide of ~$3.40-$3.50 sits below consensus of $3.62, FY26 price and organic leverage guides were cut, orders decelerated to +20% from +37%, and EMEA/China were soft.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Slower Applied and data center demand or backlog conversion, or incrementals failing to return to the 25%+ target as price accelerates.
